title: Oil price today: Crude remains above $90 as Hormuz operations remain disrupted
content: Oil prices have settled at elevated levels, staying above ninety dollars per barrel. Investors are weighing the unpredictable US-Iran situation and the potential impacts on shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz. While intermittent Middle East assaults bolster market sentiment, the absence of further escalations keeps a lid on price surges. Additionally, the UAE's suspension of financial transactions with Iran has raised regional tensions.

title: US military newspaper publisher quits amid Pentagon row over editorial freedom

The Pentagon's push for more oversight has sparked tension regarding the military newspaper's objective reporting. Their recent pieces on poor conditions and declining morale reportedly led to criticism from the Department of Defense, prompting the ousting of the ombudsman who protected editorial freedom.

title: 1968 Montana shrimp stocking led to salmon collapse and lost food for eagles and bears
content: In 1968, the introduction of opossum shrimp into Montana's lakes triggered a dramatic decline in the kokanee salmon population. The shrimp fiercely competed with young salmon for essential zooplankton, resulting in a disarrayed food chain. Meanwhile, the lake trout population thrived as they turned to the remaining salmon for sustenance. This shift irrevocably changed Flathead Lake's ecological landscape and impacted its indigenous fish communities.

title: British barley field left in 1961 became woodland in 60 years
content: A groundbreaking six-decade study reveals that passive rewilding effectively fosters the development of lush native woodlands. Through protective thorny scrub, young trees thrived, shielded from herbivores, while wind and jays ingeniously spread seeds, outlining the woodlands’ unique patterns. After fifty years, the area began to mirror the characteristics of ancient woodlands, showcasing an eco-friendly and budget-friendly approach to achieving woodland restoration objectives.

title: US issues details of new Green Card rules coming into effect from September 18

Receipt of public benefits after this date will count against applicants significantly. A broader range of benefits will now be considered by USCIS officers. The updated guidance applies to all adjustment of status applications submitted then.

title: NIA court issues non-bailable warrant against top LeT commander
content:
The NBW was issued last month against Mohammad Yaqoob, a designated terrorist of Pakistani origin.

JAMMU: A special NIA court in Jammu has issued a non-bailable warrant against a top commander of Pak-based LeT for his involvement in planning terror attacks on security forces and civilians in the Kashmir Valley. The NBW was issued last month against Mohammad Yaqoob, a designated terrorist of Pakistani origin, officials said. Yaqoob is the second top LeT terrorist against whom the NIA court in Jammu has issued an NBW since July 8, when it had issued the warrant against Hafiz Saeed, the Pakistan-based chief of the proscribed terror outfit, in connection with the Pahalgam terror attack case. According to the court order dated July 16, the warrant was sought by the NIA against Yaqoob in a case registered under UAPA, Arms Act and Explosive Substances Act at a police station in Srinagar.

title: Road to US green card gets tougher; public charge scrutiny to begin Sept 18
content: a public charge determination can result in a green card application being denied if USCIS finds that an applicant is likely to become dependent on government assistance . the change is particularly relevant to those who have spent years in the employment-based green card backlog and are preparing to file Form I-485 .

title: Vande Mataram row: BJP chief Nabin slams Congress, calls it new Muslim League
content: BJP says Congress is showing the same stubbornness against the full version of the national song . BJP national president says Congress has now institutionalised the insult to Vande Matram . the BJP has recently tried to pass off its disrespect for the song as just a coincidence .

title: Collectors of border states to decide citizenship applications under CAA
content: ministry of home affairs has notified the collectors across border states/Union territories as the “competent authority” to receive, scrutinise and dispose of applications for citizenship filed by immigrants belonging to religious minorities of Pakistan, Bangladesh and Afghanistan . only empowered committees could process and approve applications by Hindu, Sikh, Christian, Jain, Buddhists and Parsi immigrants from the three Muslim-majority neighbours .

title: Go to universities & schools to engage with young minds: PM Modi to ministers
content: the twin directives are aimed at strengthening engagement with Gen Z and Gen Alpha (aged 5-15) the overall social media performance, ranking of all ministers, was shared . amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, Nitin Gadkari, Shivraj Singh Chouhan, Piyush Goyal, Ashwini Vaishnaw and CR Paatil were among the top performers .

title: Trump-Bibi tensions deepen? US officials frustrated by Israel’s Syria strikes
content: at least eight Israeli bombs struck the runways and several hangars at the airbase early Tuesday . the strikes came as the Trump administration has sought to strengthen ties with Syria's government under president Ahmed al-Sharaa . president obama said the operation was intended to deter Turkey from sending sophisticated weapons systems to the facility .

title: Kenya helicopter crash kills 7, including 5 Americans, Ecuador intelligence chief
content: the deaths were confirmed by Kenyan authorities and the US state department . the helicopter crashed while travelling from the Loisaba Conservancy towards the Ewaso Nyiro area . seven people, six passengers and the pilot, were on board .

title: UGC-Net row: AI used recklessly to draft questions, say experts; NTA denies
content: experts say generative AI was used extensively to prepare papers . the controversy has drawn attention to the extent to which NTA has integrated AI into preparation . a six-week delay in cancelling three flawed tests is at the heart of the controversy .

title: Congress Working Committee discusses Vande Mataram, firm on singing just 2 stanzas
content: the party's chief ministers will come up with a plan to revamp education and examination systems in their states . the party has also decided to expand its "Chhatron ki Goonj" students' conventions to 800 towns and cities .

title: Paternity test of child can be allowed in marital dispute: SC
content: a man has sought divorce on the ground of alleged unchaste character of his wife . a bench of justices rejected the plea of a woman who had opposed a paternity test of the child . "if you are loyal, then why should you object to the test," the bench asked .

title: 'Economic D-Day': Trump warns countries supporting Iran of 'tremendous consequences'
content: the new measures would target any country whose financial institutions, businesses, airports or government entities provide what he described as a “lifeline” to Iran . he did not specify what penalties Washington would impose or name any country that could be targeted .

title: Mehul Choksi’s lawyer Vijay Aggarwal arrested in UK over sexual assault allegation
content: fugitive diamond businessman mehul Choksi, 57, is in jail charged with four sexual assault offences on two women . his personal assistant, manpreet Kaur, is also in jail for intentionally encouraging the commission of two offences . the pair, both Indian citizens, were arrested on Aug 11 at 29 Brick Street, Mayfair, a serviced luxury ambassadorial town house where they both were staying .
